2. Daily Summary
I walked the Cristo Rey Jesuit STEAM Building job site and documented the crew's work and the conditions in the building. The work was drywall hanging and finishing. Hangers were measuring, cutting, and installing board at walls and door frames, and ceiling board was in place around the ductwork and sprinkler lines. Finishers were taping and coating walls throughout the building, from the floor and from scissor lifts on the high walls. The crew members I photographed on scissor lifts were wearing harnesses and working inside the guardrails, and the lifts had fire extinguishers on the platforms. The crew was wearing hard hats, high-visibility shirts or vests, safety glasses, and gloves. The elevator shaft opening was guarded with two metal stud rails and danger tape. Joint compound and board were staged on pallets and in stacks, and scrap board and stud cutoffs were being collected in a tilt cart and taken to the trash hopper outside.
3. Safety Measures Verified
Personal Protective Equipment
Hard hats, high-visibility shirts or vests, safety glasses, and gloves worn by the crew members photographed.
Fall Protection on Scissor Lifts
Harnesses worn by crew members on the scissor lifts, working inside the platform guardrails.
Fire Extinguishers
Extinguishers mounted on the lift platforms and on stands in the work and mixing areas.
Elevator Shaft Opening
Opening guarded with two metal stud rails and danger tape.
Material Staging
Board and joint compound stacked on pallets and staged out of the walkways.
Housekeeping
Scrap board and stud cutoffs collected in a tilt cart and removed to the trash hopper outside.
